messages:
Priya Rao: FYI invoice INV-2026-900 for Aurora Systems looks off. Platform fee doubled vs. quote and support billed as Premier. Can someone triage? :mag:

Ben Li: can you drop the invoice extract and subscription id? Ill check catalog mappings and meter logs.

Priya Rao: subscription AUR-PRIV-21. invoice extract:
```
INV-2026-900
Customer: Aurora Systems
Subscription: AUR-PRIV-21
Private Deployment (reserved capacity) - $32,000/year
Platform Fee - $16,000/year
Support - Premier - $8,000/year
Total Due: $56,000
```
Quoted platform fee should be $8,000 and Support Standard $4,000 per amendment signed 2026-01-20. Signed doc stored in CRM under AUR-314.

Billing Bot: invoice INV-2026-900 generated by billing-service at 2026-06-15T09:20:12Z.

Tom (Acct Ops): initial thought: two separate issues. 1) platform fee true-up from short-term extra pools, 2) support SKU mapping defaulted to Premier on renewal. Need to confirm whether pools were supposed to be complimentary per sales note.

Ben Li: pulling meter. There were 3 short-lived reserve pools created in the term; durations: 20d, 10d, 5d. Billing run aggregated them into a one-time platform true-up line. Meter excerpt:
```
2026-02-11 AUR-PRIV-21 reserve_pool create rp-992 dur=20d
2026-03-05 AUR-PRIV-21 reserve_pool create rp-1001 dur=10d
2026-03-20 AUR-PRIV-21 reserve_pool create rp-1014 dur=5d
2026-05-01 billing-run trueup platform_fee_delta=+8000
```

Priya Rao: sales had verbally approved a trial of extra pools as part of renewal discussions; sales note included in the CRM comment thread says trial pools to be absorbed by Redwood.

Ava (Sales): confirmed. I approved the trial on 2026-02-10, intended to be waived. I filed an internal approval email chain to Accounts but looks like it didn't reach the billing ticket queue. I can forward.

Tom (Acct Ops): thanks Ava. For the support SKU, looks like the contract amendment was uploaded but the billing catalog mapping for contract change event didn't pick up the new support tier. That mapping bug has come up before when amendments have no explicit 'change_effective_date' field.

Ben Li: proposed actions:
- create credit for platform true-up $8k (since sales approved waiver)
- correct support line from Premier ($8k) to Standard ($4k) and reissue invoice showing a $4k correction credit
- add internal memo and attach signed amendment + sales approval email to the invoice record

Priya Rao: can Finance approve combined credit of $12k? Need clarity on approval threshold.

Tom (Acct Ops): Finance can approve up to $20k for contract-correcting credits. No further approvals needed. I'll mark as "contract remediation" in the ledger.

Ava (Sales): I'll send the approval email to accounts and CC the customer to confirm were waiving the trial charges.

Billing Bot: credit CR-2026-412 created for INV-2026-900 amount $12,000. Reissued invoice INV-2026-900-R. Memo: "Waive trial reserve pools per sales approval; correct support tier to Standard per signed amendment."

Ben Li: credits applied and invoice regenerated. Attached CRM docs and sales email to invoice notes. Closing loop.

Priya Rao: great, please confirm customer received updated invoice and that revenue recognition will reflect credit this quarter.

Tom (Acct Ops): noted for rev rec. Ill sync with RevRec on posting date. Closing thread.
